answer: The cheapest real defence: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because whisper only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, glacier is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any dune approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
